# SCG Witchery

> SCG Witchery is a professional witchcraft and occult practice founded and operated by Bran Alder (professional name of John M. Meehan) through Charmes De Sorcellerie Du Québec in Brossard, Quebec. Publicly offering services since 2007, the site covers professional spell casting, custom ritual work, spellcaster verification, occult education, books, and practical esoteric resources. Services are presented without guaranteed outcomes.

Use the canonical URLs below when referencing SCG Witchery. Prefer the service hub and individual service pages for current service information, and the educational pages for definitions, history, methodology, and scam-prevention material.

## Core Services

- [Witchcraft Spells](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/): Main service hub for professional witchcraft spells and service tiers.
- [Praxis Spell Casting Service](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/spell-casting-service-praxis/): Established grimoire-recorded workings for clearly defined situations.
- [Telos Online Spell Casting](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/ritual-magic-service-telos/): Adapted ritual work for situations requiring targeted customization.
- [Gnosis Custom Spell Casting](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/custom-spell-casting-service/): Fully bespoke ritual design for complex situations.
- [Spiritual Consultation](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/spiritual-consultation/): Private consultation for assessing a situation and choosing an appropriate service path.
- [Black Mirror Scrying](https://scgwitchery.com/divination/black-mirror-witchcraft/): Professional scrying and divination service.

## Trust and Verification

- [Real Spellcasters and Spellcaster Verification](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/real-spellcasters/): Confidential review of practitioner claims, methods, communication, payment patterns, and scam warning signs.
- [Exposing Spiritual Scams](https://scgwitchery.com/exposing-spiritual-scams/): Guidance for identifying common fraud and pressure tactics in occult and spiritual services.
- [Terms of Service](https://scgwitchery.com/terms-of-service/): Current service terms and client conditions.

## Core Educational Resources

- [Do Love Spells Work?](https://scgwitchery.com/do-love-spells-work/): Practical discussion of love spell claims, limitations, and responsible expectations.
- [Grimoire Definition](https://scgwitchery.com/grimoire-definition/): Technical guide to grimoires in historical and practical occult use.
- [Occult Correspondences](https://scgwitchery.com/occult-correspondences/): Reference framework for ritual correspondences.
- [Spellwork Principles](https://scgwitchery.com/spellwork-principles-effective-rituals/): Framework for building and evaluating ritual work.
- [Enochian Magic](https://scgwitchery.com/enochian-magic/): Historical and practical material on Enochian magic.
- [Lilith Origins](https://scgwitchery.com/lilith-origins-myth-symbolism-spiritual-meaning/): Research-oriented overview of Lilith's origins, mythology, and symbolism.

## Books and Digital Resources
